title: Tracing the Influence of Retrieved Literature on Scientific Ideation in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.39060v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate research ideas from scientific literature. Existing systems combine literature retrieval with search, generation, and refinement, making it difficult to determine how the retrieval strategy itself shapes the ideas generated. We isolate this contribution by comparing five retrieval strategies and a No Literature baseline under a shared generation protocol, using 45,000 ideas across 15 machine learning topics and ten open-weight models. Relative to no literature basline, all five retrieval strategies reduce diversity among ideas generated from the same set of papers by $5.6\%$--$17.9\%$, while most increase diversity by $10.2\%$--$18.1\%$ when ideas from different sets are pooled. translated_title: 追踪检索文献对大语言模型科学构思的影响
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于从科学文献中生成研究想法。现有系统将文献检索与搜索、生成和精炼相结合，这使得难以确定检索策略本身如何塑造所生成的想法。我们通过在统一的生成协议下比较五种检索策略与一个“无文献”基线来隔离这一贡献，实验涵盖了15个机器学习主题、十个开源权重模型，共生成45,000个想法。相对于无文献基线，所有五种检索策略使由同一组论文生成的想法之间的多样性降低了5.6%–17.9%，而当合并由不同论文组生成的想法时，大多数策略使多样性增加了10.2%–18.1%。检索对想法质量和新颖性的影响总体上较为温和，但在不同主题之间存在差异。我们进一步应用了一种基于JSD的归因方法，以追踪单篇输入论文对每个生成想法的影响。
tldr: 该研究通过在统一生成协议下对比五种文献检索策略与无文献基线（共45,000个想法），首次分离并量化了检索策略本身对LLM科学构思的影响，发现检索会降低同组论文生成想法的多样性但提高跨组想法的多样性，并提出基于JSD的归因方法追踪单篇文献对每个想法的影响。
en_tdlr: By comparing five retrieval strategies against a no-literature baseline under a shared generation protocol across 45,000 ideas, this study isolates how retrieval itself shapes LLM scientific ideation—finding retrieval reduces diversity among ideas from the same paper set but increases pooled diversity—and introduces a JSD-based attribution method to trace each input paper's influence on individual ideas.
